name: zombie
description: Clothed adult undead humanoid for a first-person shooter: 52 Humanoid bones incl. 30 finger bones, 20 regional hitboxes, 9 severable gore regions, shared motion library. All numbers are PROPOSALS to calibrate on your own accepted characters.

motion_prompts.Idle: A person stands in place with a hunched back and bent knees, breathing heavily and slowly swaying, with tense hands hanging loosely beside the body.
motion_prompts.Walk: A person walks slowly forward in a straight line with an injured stiff-legged shamble and a hunched torso, keeping the arms loosely bent in front of the body.
motion_prompts.Run: A person runs forward in a straight line with an aggressive hunched posture, taking heavy quick strides and swinging bent arms.
motion_prompts.Attack: A person stands with bent knees, winds up the right arm and lunges with one powerful right-handed clawing swipe, then recovers to a hunched standing stance.
motion_prompts.Hit: A person stands with a hunched posture, recoils sharply from a hit to the {region}, then regains a hunched standing balance.
motion_prompts.Death: A person standing upright suddenly loses balance and collapses backward onto the ground, ending lying on the back completely still.

reference_guidance: Original fictional adult only: no real-person likeness, celebrity, brand or franchise noun.
Full-body neutral A-pose, arms about 45 degrees down with hands clearly away from the thighs and visible armpits; feet slightly apart.
Consistent garment construction across front/side/back; plain neutral background; even lighting without strong shadows.
Separate matching portrait (same identity) for the face; only add side/back views that are missing.
Undead identity through proportions, dry skin, posture and clothing damage; avoid attached muscle lumps and wearable-only variants.
A reference sheet generated in one request is not calibrated multiview photography: check contradictions before multiview reconstruction.
